research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Invoca is researching machine learning approaches for analyzing and classifying spoken interactions. Work titled topic based semantic search of electronic documents based on machine learning and pitman yor process topic modeling pre seeded by keyword groupings focuses on topic models for call transcripts. Dialog analysis using voice energy level and automatic classification of phone calls using representation learning based on a hierarchical feature model support call analytics. A performance score determiner and supervised topic modeling training generation round out model evaluation and data creation.

overview_description.description: Invoca is the recognized leader in conversation intelligence AI that enables marketing, e-commerce, and contact center teams to drive efficient and profitable revenue growth by unlocking actionable insights from customer conversations. Through deep integrations with leading technology platforms, teams can turn conversation data into automated action to enhance every digital touchpoint and human interaction, leading to better experiences, more conversions, and higher revenue. With Invoca, top consumer brands, including AutoNation, DIRECTV, Mayo Clinic, Mutual of Omaha, and Verizon, experience unbelievable results powered by undeniable data. Invoca has raised $184M from leading venture capitalists, including Upfront Ventures, Accel, Silver Lake Waterman, H.I.G. Growth Partners, and Salesforce Ventures. For more information, visit www.invoca.com.

product.name: Invoca Platform

product.name: AI Messaging Agent
product.description: An AI-powered SMS agent that engages, qualifies, and converts web and phone leads through automated text conversations.

product.name: Call Tracking
product.description: A call-tracking and analytics service that attributes inbound calls and their outcomes to marketing sources, campaigns, ads, and keywords.

product.name: Signal AI
product.description: An AI conversation-intelligence product that analyzes phone interactions to identify outcomes, customer insights, and marketing performance signals.

product.name: Marketing Attribution
product.description: A marketing measurement service that connects online and offline customer interactions to leads, calls, appointments, sales, and revenue.
